\begin{lemma}[Three-Point Property of Tseng \cite{tseng2008accelerated}]
    \label{lemma:Tseng-3point}
    Let $\phi(x)$ be a convex function, and let $D_h(\cdot,\cdot)$ be the Bregman distance for $h(\cdot)$. For a given vector $z$, let
    $z_+:=\argmin_{x\in Q} \phi(x) + D_h(x,z).$
    Then 
    $$\phi(x)+D_h(x,z)\geq\phi(z_+) + D_h(z_+,z) + D_h(x,z_+), \quad\forall x\in Q.$$
\end{lemma}

\begin{proof}
     By Lemma \ref{lemma:B.1} and the assumption that $f$ is $L$-smooth adaptable to $h$, we know 
     $$\max\left\{\|\nabla^2f(x)\|: x\in\cX\right\} \leq \max\left\{L\|\nabla^2h(x)\|: x\in\cX\right\} = L\cdot L_h(\cX).$$
     As $\cX$ is convex, the line segment $[x,y]\subseteq\cX$ and hence 
     $$\|\nabla f(z_\theta)-\nabla f(y)\|^2\leq L^2L_h^2(\cX)\|z_\theta-y\|^2 = L^2\theta^2 L_h^2(\cX)\|x-y\|^2.$$
     Combined with    the fact that $$D_h(x,y)\geq\frac{\mu_h([x,y])}{2}\|x-y\|^2\geq  \frac{\mu_h(\cX)}{2}\|x-y\|^2,$$
     we obtain
     $$\frac{\|\nabla f(z_\theta)-\nabla f(y)\|^2}{2L^2\mu_h(\cX)} \leq \theta^2\cdot\frac{L_h^2(\cX)}{\mu_h^2(\cX)}\cdot\frac{\mu_h(\cX)}{2}\|x-y\|^2\leq \theta^2\kappa_h^2(\cX)D_h(x,y),$$
     where KC-regularity guarantees that $\kappa_h(\cX)$ is always upper bounded by $\kappa_h^\delta$.
\end{proof}

nodes.title: 光滑强凸标准估计
declaration_text: For a differentiable convex function g with L-Lipschitz gradient and strong convexity modulus μ>0, the standard gradient Lipschitz, strong monotonicity, and gradient-function-gap estimates apply. In particular, at a minimizer x with ∇g(x)=0, ||∇g(y)||²/(2L) ≤ g(y)-g(x) ≤ ||∇g(y)||²/(2μ). These are the Nesterov estimates invoked by the author for the Bregman function in B0027.

nodes.title: 光滑适应下降事实
declaration_text: The cited extended descent lemma of Bolte et al. states that convexity of Lh+f and Lh-f implies |f(x)-f(y)-<∇f(y),x-y>| ≤ L D_h(x,y).

nodes.title: 凸近端三点事实
declaration_text: Tseng's cited three-point property: if z+ minimizes a convex function a(x)+D_h(x,z) over a convex set Q, then a(x)+D_h(x,z) ≥ a(z+)+D_h(z+,z)+D_h(x,z+) for every x∈Q.

nodes.title: 递归估计方差事实
declaration_text: For the finite-sum SARAH recursion initialized by an exact gradient and using independent uniform sampling with replacement, the estimation-error second moment accumulates the conditional variances of the sampled gradient-difference increments. For a batch of size b, its increment variance is at most (bn)^{-1} times the sum of squared component gradient differences. These are the cited Pham et al. Lemma 2 and standard sample-average variance identities underlying B0218 and B0088.

declaration_text: For a real symmetric matrix A, its operator norm is the largest absolute eigenvalue and λmax(A)=max_{x≠0}(xᵀAx)/(xᵀx). For B positive semidefinite, ||B||=λmax(B).
